details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:136-138,163-167 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Phase 3 replaces the inlined trusted canonical agents.md for the review editor, judges and consolidator with on-demand reads of a PR-controlled agents.md, and the plan does not state this change in trust.
  WHY: A PR that edits agents.md or AGENTS.md can change the conventions the review roles read; the reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:8,46,58-60,79-81,130-131,197-198 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "under 60 KB" target cannot be met: a non-agents remainder of about 56.6 KB plus the 15 KB index (D3) gives about 71 KB for clarify and plan.
  WHY: The planned size-guard test and the Phase 1 done criterion cannot pass, and the plan does not say whether the index or the target should change.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:121-122,169-172 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Phase 4 removes the system-instruction block from the prompt for Claude, but the ai_engine.sh exit-75 fallback runs codex on the same prompt file (ai_engine.sh:604, 790-799).
  WHY: The codex fallback would run without the unattended rules and output contract; the plan names no mechanism to keep that path intact.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:72-76,82-84,133-138,156-161 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan assumes agents.md is readable in every phase's sandbox but verified it only for clarify, snapshot-readonly and implement. Heal intake mounts only HEAL_SOURCE_DIR and HEAL_BRANCH_TIP_DIR, and the review canonical file sits outside the checkout.
  WHY: The inline fallback fires only when the index build fails, so an index pointing at an unreadable file silently loses the agents.md content.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:105-109,143-150,174-189 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not say where agents.rendered.md is written per phase, and its file list omits review_commit_changes.sh and review_conflict_resolve.sh.
  WHY: The clarify /source whitelist drops the new file, and in implement and review an untracked generated file can trip commit or scope checks.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:11-13,113-115,143-144,178-189 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: scripts/build_agents_index.py is never added to the per-workflow staged-script lists (clarify.yml:483, plan.yml:590, implement.yml:1474, orchestrate.yml:466, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:489, orchestrate_poll.yml:614, validate.yml:570, and review_autofix.yml:288 per z-ai_glm-5_3-flash).
  WHY: Consumer repos would silently fall back to the inline 708 KB prefix.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:114,181 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: "(see Q2)" has no referent because the Decisions are labelled D1-D3; self_heal_validation.sh is listed but no step touches it; orchestrate_poll.yml and validate.yml are missing from the workflow list.
  WHY: Documentation drift misleads the implementer about scope and about whether the default was confirmed.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 5, Phase 4 step 8 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The wording updates cover only the agents.md part of the "provided ABOVE in this prompt" sentences in run_plan_codex.sh and mode-validate-generate.txt, and the system-instructions part becomes false after Phase 4.
  WHY: Claude-engine plan and validate prompts would claim content is above when it is not.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: All four phases are behind STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE (index by default, inline to roll back).
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md Phase 4 (lines 169-172, step 8) and rollback line 139
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Phase 4 removes the system-instruction block from stdin with no STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE condition, and its rollback is "revert" rather than setting the mode to inline.
- requirement: Phase 2 switches the orchestrate-poll judges and validation prefix to the shared index helper.
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md Phase 2 and Files & Modules; .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:614 and .github/workflows/validate.yml:570 staged-script lists
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Phase 2 changes orchestrate_poll_process.sh and validate_process.sh but never stages build_agents_index.py, and the Files & Modules workflow list (lines 178-179) omits both workflows. minimax_minimax-m3 adds that stage_workflow_support.sh is listed at line 185 with no step to wire the helper into its manifest.
- requirement: Update every prompt sentence that says all context is already inlined.
  expected_change_site: prompts/_templates/mode-validate-generate.txt:7-9 (add to Approach step 5 and Files & Modules)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Step 5 lists only clarify.yml:1466, run_plan_codex.sh:16 and prompts/mode-validate-generate.txt:15. The hand-maintained template has the same wording and is not listed, and validate.yml:700-718 and tests/test_validate_semble_contract.py:48 reference it.
- requirement: After Phase 4, prompt text must not make false claims about where the system instructions live.
  expected_change_site: scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:15-17 and prompts/_templates/mode-validate-generate.txt:7-8 (Phase 4 / step 8)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: run_plan_codex.sh:15-17 says the system instructions are "provided ABOVE in this prompt"; Phase 1 step 4 updates only the agents.md part and no Phase 4 step fixes the system-instructions part.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Phase 3 step 7 (review_autofix.yml:2630-2695) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Phase 3 drops the inlined canonical agents file from the editor, judge and consolidator prompts, which would then read a PR-controlled agents.md that the review prompt treats as untrusted data.
  WHY: A PR that edits agents.md or AGENTS.md can change the conventions the editor reads, and the plan does not mention this change in trust.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Summary lines 4-8, Context, Goals, D3 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A 56.6 KB non-agents prefix plus a 15 KB index gives about 71 KB, against the "under 60 KB" goal.
  WHY: The planned size-guard test cannot pass for clarify or plan under D3.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Phase 4 / Approach step 6 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: scripts/ai_engine.sh:604 passes --system-prompt-file /support/instructions.md, and the exit-75 fallback runs codex on the same prompt file, so removing the system block leaves codex without rules.
  WHY: On a Claude capacity exit the fallback Codex run executes without the system instructions, and the plan names no mechanism to keep the codex path intact.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 5, Phase 4 step 8 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Only the agents.md part of the "provided ABOVE in this prompt" sentences is updated, so the system-instructions part becomes false after Phase 4.
  WHY: Claude-engine plan and validate prompts would tell the model that content is above when it is not.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Context sandbox visibility; Phase 2 step 6; Phase 3 step 7; Approach step 3 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Sandbox visibility was checked only for clarify, snapshot-readonly and implement, yet the same assumption is applied to the other phases. Heal intake includes only HEAL_SOURCE_DIR and HEAL_BRANCH_TIP_DIR (lines 2436, 2460), and the review canonical file is outside the checkout.
  WHY: The fallback fires only on index-build failure, so the agents content is lost without a signal.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 1, Files & Modules | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The plan does not say where agents.rendered.md is written per phase; the clarify /source whitelist drops a new root file, and implement/review checkouts may flag it, and review_commit_changes.sh and review_conflict_resolve.sh are not listed.
  WHY: In clarify the file is invisible, and in implement and review it can trip scope or integrity guards.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 3 "(see Q2)"; Files & Modules | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "Q2" has no referent (decisions are D1-D3), self_heal_validation.sh is listed but untouched, and orchestrate_poll.yml and validate.yml are missing from the workflow list.
  WHY: Documentation drift misleads the implementer about scope and about whether the default was confirmed.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 3, Phase 1 step 5, Files & Modules | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: build_agents_index.py is not added to the staged-script lists (clarify.yml:483, plan.yml:590, implement.yml:1474, orchestrate.yml:466, orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:489, orchestrate_poll.yml:614, validate.yml:570).
  WHY: Consumer repos fall back to the inline path and keep the full 708 KB prefix.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "All four phases are behind the new STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE (index by default, inline to roll back)."
  Expected change site: docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md, Phase 4 (step 8 and the Phases & Merge Strategy entry)
  Evidence of absence: Phase 4 removes the system-instruction block with no reference to STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE; its rollback is "Rollback: revert".
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Phase 2 switches the hand-built prefixes (orchestrate-poll judges, validate) to the shared index helper.
  Expected change site: Phase 2 and Files & Modules; staged-script lists in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml and .github/workflows/validate.yml
  Evidence of absence: Phase 2 step 6 changes orchestrate_poll_process.sh and validate_process.sh but never stages build_agents_index.py; the workflow list omits both workflows.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Update every prompt sentence that says the context is already inlined.
  Expected change site: Approach step 5 and Files & Modules (add prompts/_templates/mode-validate-generate.txt)
  Evidence of absence: Step 5 lists clarify.yml:1466, run_plan_codex.sh:16 and prompts/mode-validate-generate.txt:15; the template copy carries the same wording and is not listed.
  severity=NIT | confidence=4
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
